description: frost_giant default look, LIGHT proxy finish: the colour is the Pixal3D proxy's own texture (grey-slate ice lifted to the sheet's pale icy blues, icicles / claws / horns to the sheet's deeper blues, seams to the seam blue, eye slits to the glow cyan) baked onto the low (improved/textures/frost_giant_basecolor.png); proxy_albedo (white) tints it; one GLOW region (the eye slits) carries the emission (Glow -> Emission Color)

proxy_albedo.note: tint over the baked proxy albedo (light mode); white keeps the ice as baked. Sheet chips for reference: 212,234,250 / 167,213,243 / 128,190,238 / seams 50,120,183

eye_glow.note: the eye-slit glow (sheet glow chip 96,210,251); rgb white keeps the baked albedo
